build_system: Vite 6 with tsc for type checking
test_command: No test command - use build for validation
verification_instructions: Run 'npm run build' in /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany/dashboard to verify TypeScript compilation and Vite bundling pass with zero errors
contribution_requirements: All redesigned pages use static mock data, no API calls, no randomness
key_patterns: Pages import Card from '@/components/common/Card', use lucide-react for icons, recharts for charts, Tailwind CSS for styling. Pages follow pattern: static mock data at top, helper components if needed, main export function. Layout uses flex with gap for sidebar pages (see Tasks.tsx). Dark theme colors: dark-bg (#0f1117), dark-surface (#1a1b2e), dark-card (#1e2035). Stat cards use Card with padding='lg'. Tables use Card with padding='none'. Charts use ResponsiveContainer. Text colors: white for primary, gray-400 for secondary, gray-500 for tertiary.
directory_structure: dashboard/src/pages/ contains all page components, dashboard/src/components/common/ has shared components (Card, Badge, Button, etc.), dashboard/src/App.tsx has routing
